description: This file contains utility functions for evaluating object detection models, including functions to compute average precision, perform detections on datasets, retrieve annotations, and evaluate model performance using metrics like mAP. It also imports visualization and anchor computation modules, indicating its role in the evaluation pipeline of a detection system.

methods.name: _compute_ap(recall, precision)
methods.description: Calculates average precision from recall and precision curves.

methods.name: _get_detections(generator, model, score_threshold=0.05, max_detections=100, save_path=None)
methods.description: Generates detection results from a model over a dataset with optional visualization.

methods.name: _get_annotations(generator)
methods.description: Retrieves ground truth annotations from a data generator.

methods.name: evaluate( generator, model, iou_threshold=0.5, score_threshold=0.05, max_detections=100, save_path=None )
methods.description: Main evaluation function computing AP per class and average inference time across dataset.

ctags.name: evaluate
ctags.signature: ( generator, model, iou_threshold=0.5, score_threshold=0.05, max_detections=100, save_path=None )
